## Specific task description

Task instruction: Hold the iron skillet for frying foods with the right arm; the other arm places the bread with golden crust.

Task description: Put the golden-brown bread on the left into the black iron frying pan on the right. The right arm holds the pan and the left arm places the bread. At completion, both the pan and bread must remain lifted.

Success criteria: The left arm places the bread inside the skillet held by the right arm, with the bread body horizontally close to the skillet's target placement position. Both that target position and the bread body are clearly above the table; merely bringing them together on the table is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- With the right gripper, consider the long handle extending toward the lower right of the image. Choose a solid section near the skillet body but with finger clearance from the rim, span the handle width, and avoid the end hole to reduce wobbling while holding it.
- The left gripper may grasp flatter middle sections of opposite sides of the golden bread, opening slightly wider than local width. Confirm the fingers straddle it before closing to avoid touching only the upper edge and pushing it aside.
- Keep the pan opening facing upward and the base nearly level while holding it. Reduce right-arm movement as the bread approaches the pan to avoid the rim hitting the left gripper or the bread sliding to one side after it lands.
- When approaching the pan, first clear its rim with the bread's bottom and leave descent space for both fingers. Release once the pan bottom supports the bread, then withdraw through space above the opening to reduce drops, wall collisions or dragging the bread.
